newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Twelve firms eye 20 pct of Philippine steel firm.
newsitem.headline: Twelve firms eye 20 pct of Philippine steel firm.

text.p: Twelve foreign and local companies have expressed interest to buy 20 percent of the National Steel Corp of the Philippines, state-owned National Development Co (NDC) said on Wednesday.
NDC general manager Arthur Aguilar said the 20 percent government stake, which includes 448 million shares, would be bidded out in four equal blocks on October 2.
NDC has set a floor price of 10 pesos per share.
The interested buyers include Tomen Corp, Mitsui & Co Ltd, Kawasho Corp, Marubeni Corp, Urban Bank, and APC Group Inc.
The NSC is 75 percent owned by Malaysia's Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd.
The remaining 5.0 percent stake would be sold to small investors at a later date.
NSC is one of the major steel producers in the country, cornering 39 percent of the domestic market.
